items.name: UCLA Westerns Warmup 2025
items.information:
This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). If you are new to competing, please refer to the [Competitor Responsibilities](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/UCLAWesternsWarmup2025#62644-competitor-responsibilities) tab.

Spectators can attend for free and can come and go as they please! No registration or check-in process is needed for spectating.

This competition is organized in partnership with [West Coast Cubing](https://www.westcoastcubing.com/) and [SpeedCubeShop](https://speedcubeshop.com/).

![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBZ0dKIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--60fae70c3e469b91d58257f4370c58af47b487da/scswcc5.png)

### UCLA Students
If you are a UCLA Student or Faculty member, your registration fee for this competition will be waived. Register for the competition without paying, and contact the [organization team](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/contact?competitionId=UCLAWesternsWarmup2025&contactRecipient=competition) with your credentials (such as a student ID) attached. Your registration will be accepted in the order in which this email is received.

items.name: Cubing by the Kings OH 2025
items.information:
This competition takes place on **SUNDAY**. If you are interested in also participating in PBQ events, click [here](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/QuietbytheKingsOH2025) to view the page for the Quiet by the Kings OH 2025 competition taking place on Saturday, or see [here](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions?region=all&search=ohio&state=present&year=all+years&from_date=&to_date=&delegate=&display=list) for a list of other upcoming competitions in Ohio. 

If you are a first-time competitor, the [Registration Process and FAQ](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CubingbytheKingsOH2025#59516-registration-process-and-faq-for-new-competitors) tab has useful information how the competition will look. All competitiors must read the [Competitior Information](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CubingbytheKingsOH2025#59517-competitor-information-must-read) tab before registering.

You can find out about upcoming competitions in our area in our local Facebook group: [Ohio and Michigan Speedcubing](https://www.facebook.com/groups/1655301714974534/)

Cubing by the Kings OH 2025 is supported by the [Midwest Cubing Association](www.midwestcubing.org)

* **Nuevos Competidores:** hemos creado una [pestaña exclusiva](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/RoadtoNatsValencia2025#61960-nuevos-competidores-new-competitors) para ustedes. Muy importante leerla.

**Please read all the tabs before registering; there is a lot of important information you should know, even if you are a recurring competitor.**

* Competitor registration limit: **50**.

items.information:
*English:*

This competition will hold **only 3x3x3 Fewest Moves event**, and it will be held in multiple locations, across Latin America. Please pay attention to the **date and time zone** of your [location](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/FMCLatinAmerica2025#62723-locations-lugares)!

Locations may be added until the 9th of august 23:59UTC so if there isn't a location near you yet contact your local [Delegate](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/delegates) in Latin America.

---

*Español:*

Esta competencia tendrá **solo el evento 3x3x3 Menos Movimientos**, y se llevará a cabo en múltiples ubicaciones en América Latina. ¡Preste atención a la **fecha y zona horaria** de su [ubicación](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/FMCLatinAmerica2025#62723-locations-lugares)!

Se pueden agregar ubicaciones hasta el 9 de agosto a las 23:59 UTC, por lo que si aún no hay una ubicación cerca de usted, comuníquese con su [Delegado](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/delegates) local en América Latina.

---

*Português:*

Esta competição contará **apenas com a modalidade 3x3x3 Menos Movimentos** e será realizada em vários locais da América Latina. Preste atenção à **data e fuso horário** da sua [localidade](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/FMCLatinAmerica2025#62723-locations-lugares)!

Os locais podem ser adicionados até 9 de agosto às 23h59 UTC, portanto, se ainda não houver um local próximo a você, entre em contato com o [Delegado](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/delegates) local na América Latina.
